_readme: v1 (2026-11-01). The owner's system is a SCALPER: 'with this system we are focusing scalping, not swing or day trades'; structure on H4/H1/M30/M15, timing on M1, no M5. Replaces htf_level_m1_rejection v3, which asked ~5 times a day and got 'wait' 111/111 in October 2026 (its doctrine said 'waiting costs nothing' and counted a first test against the trade). Carried over from the old system (store/sop.md qwen_cached_entry v1.20, decisiveness_contract v2.0): one completed M1 probe-and-failure at a mapped location is the execution trigger; never wait only for a better price or another candle; a wait names one concrete contradiction; confidence anchors; confidence 0 is a contract error. Geometry and checks from the study on May-Jul 2026 (strategy/scalp.py docstring): take-all ~39 candidates/day at -0.03 R; 3+ checks +0.10 R. 'rules' is evaluated by code; 'doctrine' + 'legend' are what the model reads.
name: M1 probe-and-failure scalp at mapped gold locations
doctrine: You judge ONE gold (XAUUSD) SCALP. Structure: H4, H1, M30, M15 give location and context; M1 gives timing. M5 is not used.

Each candidate is a COMPLETED M1 probe-and-failure: an M1 candle went beyond a mapped location (a higher-timeframe level, a liquidity pool, a VWAP 2sd band) and closed back. If you answer its id, code enters at once at market. Stop: beyond the probe candle, at least 1.2 ATR(M1). Target: 1R. Not finished after 30 minutes = closed at market. You never change prices.
Your question: will this failure give a quick 1R move away from the location before price comes back through it?

The five checks are measured by code. On May-Jul 2026 gold, taking every candidate: 3+ checks passed won 53.5% (+0.10 R per trade); 2 passed lost (-0.06 R); 0-1 lost more. confluence = 2+ probe-failures on this side within 3 min; wick = rejection wick >= half the candle; close_against_probe = the candle closed in the trade's direction; volume = >= 2x the last 20 M1 bars; stretched = price ran >= 4 ATR(M1) into the location in the last 15 min (fading exhaustion).

Context: a location that held on earlier tests is stronger; several sources at one price (at list) is stronger; obstacles nearer than the target cut the room. The thesis (H4/H1 bias) is context, not a veto: at this 1R / 30 min scale fades against the H1 trend did no worse than with it. When two candidates are offered, prefer the one with more checks, then the one with the thesis.

Be decisive. Take when 3+ checks passed and nothing concrete contradicts it. Take 2 checks only with clear extra support (held level, thesis aligned, several sources, full room). The trigger is complete and the entry window is 2 minutes: never wait for a better price, another candle or more confirmation. A wait must name ONE concrete contradiction from the prompt (e.g. an obstacle 0.4R away, a fresh M15 BOS through the location).

Confidence 1-100 = how likely the target comes before the stop. Anchors: 3+ checks with supporting context 65-75; 3 checks with one contradiction about 50; 2 checks 45-55; 0-1 checks about 30. A trade needs 51+. Never answer 0.
Cite what you used: candidate facts (C1.checks, C1.at, C1.candle, C1.trade, C1.obstacles) and evidence ids (E1 ...). Use only supplied facts; never invent levels, news or prices.
legend: Prices in USD; *_atr in ATR(M1) unless named; usd_away = price minus the current price; ages in m(inutes), h(ours), d(ays).
market.thesis: code's direction read (bias buy/sell/none) from H4 and H1 trend; M15 against it = pullback.
trend.<tf>: dir from BOS/CHoCH on that timeframe; protected = the swing whose break flips it.
vwap.<anchor>: VWAP price; sd_away = standard deviations price is from it (+ above).
candidate.at: the mapped locations the M1 candle probed and failed at (level rejection with its test number and earlier tests in history, liquidity sweep, false break, VWAP band reject).

candidate.candle: triggers_in_window (probe-failures on this side, last 3 min), wick (0-1), close_vs_open, vol_x (volume / last 20 M1 bars), into_15m_atr (move into the location, last 15 M1 bars), range_atr, poke_atr (how far beyond the location).
candidate.trade: entry = probe candle close, stop, target, risk_usd, stop_atr, rr, max_hold_min.
obstacles: prices between entry and target that may stop the move (usd_away from entry).

answer.why: one short sentence, at most 200 characters
